text: Arrivederci, dottore!

tr.en: Goodbye, doctor!
tr.nl: Tot ziens, dokter!

text: Buongiorno, professore!

tr.en: Good morning, professor!
tr.nl: Goedemorgen, professor!

text: Grazie, amore!

tr.en: Thanks, love!
tr.nl: Dank je, schat!

text: Mi piace la pasta con il sugo.

tr.en: I like pasta with sauce.
tr.nl: Ik hou van pasta met saus.

text: Che tristezza!

tr.en: How sad!
tr.nl: Wat triest!

text: Nei suoi occhi c'è tristezza.

tr.en: There is sadness in her eyes.
tr.nl: Er ligt verdriet in haar ogen.

text: I bambini entrano in classe.

tr.en: The children go into the classroom.
tr.nl: De kinderen gaan de klas in.

text: Gli studenti ascoltano la lezione.

tr.en: The students listen to the lesson.
tr.nl: De studenten luisteren naar de les.

text: La figlia di Marco diventa medico.

tr.en: Marco's daughter is becoming a doctor.
tr.nl: De dochter van Marco wordt arts.

text: La gente diventa nervosa.

tr.en: People are getting nervous.
tr.nl: De mensen worden zenuwachtig.

text: Passiamo l'esame?

tr.en: Are we going to pass the exam?
tr.nl: Halen we het examen?

text: Speri di diventare medico?

tr.en: Do you hope to become a doctor?
tr.nl: Hoop je arts te worden?

text: Speri di passare l'esame?

tr.en: Are you hoping to pass the exam?
tr.nl: Hoop je voor het examen te slagen?

text: Noi non perdiamo la speranza.

tr.en: We don't lose hope.
tr.nl: Wij verliezen de hoop niet.

text: Noi non intendiamo restare.

tr.en: We don't intend to stay.
tr.nl: Wij zijn niet van plan te blijven.

text: Intendete restare a cena?

tr.en: Do you intend to stay for dinner?
tr.nl: Zijn jullie van plan te blijven eten?

text: Quando ricevi i soldi?

tr.en: When do you get the money?
tr.nl: Wanneer krijg je het geld?

text: Lui non riceve risposta.

tr.en: He gets no answer.
tr.nl: Hij krijgt geen antwoord.

text: Loro non ricevono risposta.

tr.en: They get no answer.
tr.nl: Zij krijgen geen antwoord.

text: Gli studenti intendono restare.

tr.en: The students intend to stay.
tr.nl: De studenten zijn van plan te blijven.

text: Noi rispondiamo con un sorriso.

tr.en: We answer with a smile.
tr.nl: Wij antwoorden met een glimlach.

text: Rendo i soldi a Luca.

tr.en: I'm giving the money back to Luca.
tr.nl: Ik geef Luca het geld terug.

text: Rendo la penna a Elena.

tr.en: I'm giving the pen back to Elena.
tr.nl: Ik geef de pen terug aan Elena.

text: Rendi i soldi a Paolo?

tr.en: Are you giving the money back to Paolo?
tr.nl: Geef je Paolo het geld terug?

text: Perché non rendi la penna a Luca?

tr.en: Why don't you give the pen back to Luca?
tr.nl: Waarom geef je de pen niet terug aan Luca?

text: Rendiamo i soldi a Marco e Anna.

tr.en: We're giving the money back to Marco and Anna.
tr.nl: We geven Marco en Anna het geld terug.

text: Rendiamo la penna a Tom?

tr.en: Shall we give the pen back to Tom?
tr.nl: Zullen we de pen teruggeven aan Tom?

text: Rendete i soldi a Giovanni?

tr.en: Are you giving the money back to Giovanni?
tr.nl: Geven jullie Giovanni het geld terug?

text: I ragazzi rendono i soldi a Sara.

tr.en: The boys give the money back to Sara.
tr.nl: De jongens geven Sara het geld terug.

text: I bambini non capiscono la domanda.

tr.en: The children don't understand the question.
tr.nl: De kinderen begrijpen de vraag niet.

text: Gli studenti finiscono l'esame.

tr.en: The students finish the exam.
tr.nl: De studenten maken het examen af.

text: Quando finiscono le lezioni?

tr.en: When do classes end?
tr.nl: Wanneer zijn de lessen afgelopen?

text: Chi scopre la risposta vince.

tr.en: Whoever finds the answer wins.
tr.nl: Wie het antwoord vindt, wint.

text: Gli studenti seguono la lezione.

tr.en: The students follow the lesson.
tr.nl: De studenten volgen de les.

text: Voi partite e noi restiamo.

tr.en: You leave and we stay.
tr.nl: Jullie vertrekken en wij blijven.

text: Dove spariscono i soldi?

tr.en: Where does the money go?
tr.nl: Waar blijft het geld?

text: I ragazzi divertono la classe.

tr.en: The boys entertain the class.
tr.nl: De jongens vermaken de klas.

text: In famiglia gestisco io i soldi.

tr.en: In the family I manage the money.
tr.nl: In het gezin beheer ik het geld.

text: Come gestisci il lavoro e la famiglia?

tr.en: How do you manage work and family?
tr.nl: Hoe combineer je werk en gezin?

text: Come gestiamo il lavoro?

tr.en: How do we manage the work?
tr.nl: Hoe pakken we het werk aan?

text: Voi gestite bene i soldi.

tr.en: You manage the money well.
tr.nl: Jullie gaan goed met geld om.

text: Io soffro per amore.

tr.en: I'm suffering for love.
tr.nl: Ik heb liefdesverdriet.

text: Voi soffrite per amore?

tr.en: Are you suffering for love?
tr.nl: Hebben jullie liefdesverdriet?

text: Gli studenti soffrono per gli esami.

tr.en: The students suffer over their exams.
tr.nl: De studenten hebben het zwaar met de examens.

text: Io impazzisco con questo lavoro.

tr.en: I'm going crazy with this job.
tr.nl: Ik word gek van dit werk.

text: Noi non impazziamo, siamo calmi.

tr.en: We're not going crazy, we're calm.
tr.nl: Wij worden niet gek, we zijn kalm.

text: Voi impazzite con il lavoro?

tr.en: Are you going crazy with work?
tr.nl: Worden jullie gek van het werk?

text: Io non ottengo mai una risposta.

tr.en: I never get an answer.
tr.nl: Ik krijg nooit antwoord.

text: Tu ottieni molto con un sorriso.

tr.en: You get a lot with a smile.
tr.nl: Met een glimlach bereik jij veel.

text: Quando otteniamo una risposta?

tr.en: When do we get an answer?
tr.nl: Wanneer krijgen we antwoord?

text: I ragazzi devono studiare per l'esame.

tr.en: The boys have to study for the exam.
tr.nl: De jongens moeten voor het examen studeren.

text: Morite di paura anche voi?

tr.en: Are you scared to death too?
tr.nl: Zijn jullie ook doodsbang?

text: Lei ottiene il lavoro.

tr.en: She gets the job.
tr.nl: Zij krijgt de baan.

text: Hanno avuto paura durante il viaggio?

tr.en: Were they scared during the trip?
tr.nl: Waren ze bang tijdens de reis?

text: Gli studenti hanno fatto i compiti insieme.

tr.en: The students did their homework together.
tr.nl: De studenten hebben samen hun huiswerk gemaakt.

text: Abbiamo voluto studiare insieme per l'esame.

tr.en: We wanted to study together for the exam.
tr.nl: We wilden samen voor het examen studeren.

text: Non hanno voluto aspettare il dottore.

tr.en: They didn't want to wait for the doctor.
tr.nl: Ze wilden niet op de dokter wachten.

text: Gli studenti hanno voluto fare una domanda.

tr.en: The students wanted to ask a question.
tr.nl: De studenten wilden een vraag stellen.

text: Perché non hai potuto venire alla riunione?

tr.en: Why couldn't you come to the meeting?
tr.nl: Waarom kon je niet naar de vergadering komen?

text: Hai potuto finire il progetto in tempo?

tr.en: Did you manage to finish the project on time?
tr.nl: Kon je het project op tijd afmaken?

text: I miei colleghi non hanno potuto lavorare oggi.

tr.en: My colleagues couldn't work today.
tr.nl: Mijn collega's konden vandaag niet werken.

text: Voi avete dovuto studiare molto per l'esame?

tr.en: Did you have to study a lot for the exam?
tr.nl: Moesten jullie veel studeren voor het examen?

text: Tu non hai saputo rispondere alla domanda.

tr.en: You couldn't answer the question.
tr.nl: Jij wist het antwoord op de vraag niet.

text: Da chi hai saputo che ho perso il lavoro?

tr.en: Who told you that I lost my job?
tr.nl: Van wie heb je gehoord dat ik mijn baan kwijt ben?

text: Hai saputo dove abita il nuovo professore?

tr.en: Did you find out where the new teacher lives?
tr.nl: Heb je ontdekt waar de nieuwe leraar woont?

text: Avete saputo rispondere alla domanda del professore?

tr.en: Were you able to answer the teacher's question?
tr.nl: Konden jullie de vraag van de leraar beantwoorden?

text: I miei colleghi hanno saputo del nuovo capo.

tr.en: My colleagues have heard about the new boss.
tr.nl: Mijn collega's hebben over de nieuwe baas gehoord.

text: Che cosa hai detto al professore?

tr.en: What did you say to the teacher?
tr.nl: Wat heb je tegen de leraar gezegd?

text: Abbiamo detto grazie al cameriere.

tr.en: We said thank you to the waiter.
tr.nl: We hebben de ober bedankt.

text: I miei genitori hanno parlato con il professore.

tr.en: My parents spoke with the teacher.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders hebben met de leraar gesproken.

text: Non abbiamo capito la domanda.

tr.en: We didn't understand the question.
tr.nl: We hebben de vraag niet begrepen.

text: Hanno preso la mia penna!

tr.en: They took my pen!
tr.nl: Ze hebben mijn pen gepakt!

text: Perché hanno lasciato il lavoro?

tr.en: Why did they quit their jobs?
tr.nl: Waarom hebben ze hun baan opgezegd?

text: Abbiamo chiesto la strada a un poliziotto.

tr.en: We asked a police officer for directions.
tr.nl: We hebben een agent de weg gevraagd.

text: Siamo stati molto fortunati.

tr.en: We were very lucky.
tr.nl: We hebben veel geluk gehad.

text: Perché non sono venuti alla riunione?

tr.en: Why didn't they come to the meeting?
tr.nl: Waarom zijn ze niet naar de vergadering gekomen?

text: Ti sono sembrato nervoso ieri?

tr.en: Did I seem nervous to you yesterday?
tr.nl: Leek ik gisteren zenuwachtig?

text: Io sono sembrata troppo giovane al capo.

tr.en: I seemed too young to the boss.
tr.nl: De baas vond mij te jong.

text: Come ti sono sembrato alla riunione?

tr.en: How did I come across at the meeting?
tr.nl: Hoe kwam ik over op de vergadering?

text: Io vi sono sembrato annoiato?

tr.en: Did I seem bored to you?
tr.nl: Leek ik verveeld?

text: All'esame sono sembrato calmo, ma ho avuto paura.

tr.en: In the exam I seemed calm, but I was scared.
tr.nl: Bij het examen leek ik rustig, maar ik was bang.

text: Io sono sembrato sorpreso, vero?

tr.en: I looked surprised, didn't I?
tr.nl: Ik leek verrast, toch?

text: Sei sembrato molto sicuro alla riunione.

tr.en: You seemed very confident at the meeting.
tr.nl: Je kwam heel zeker over op de vergadering.

text: Perché sei sembrato così arrabbiato?

tr.en: Why did you seem so angry?
tr.nl: Waarom leek je zo boos?

text: Al professore sei sembrata molto brava.

tr.en: The teacher thought you were very good.
tr.nl: De leraar vond je erg goed.

text: Non mi sei sembrato preoccupato.

tr.en: You didn't seem worried to me.
tr.nl: Je leek me niet bezorgd.

text: L'esame mi è sembrato facile.

tr.en: The exam seemed easy to me.
tr.nl: Het examen leek me makkelijk.

text: Al cameriere siamo sembrati turisti.

tr.en: To the waiter we looked like tourists.
tr.nl: De ober dacht dat we toeristen waren.

text: Siamo sembrate troppo giovani per il lavoro.

tr.en: We seemed too young for the job.
tr.nl: We leken te jong voor de baan.

text: Alla polizia siamo sembrati nervosi.

tr.en: We seemed nervous to the police.
tr.nl: De politie vond dat we nerveus leken.

text: Vi siamo sembrati arrabbiati?

tr.en: Did we seem angry to you?
tr.nl: Leken we boos?

text: Forse siamo sembrati troppo gelosi.

tr.en: Maybe we seemed too jealous.
tr.nl: Misschien leken we te jaloers.

text: Siete sembrate molto sicure all'esame.

tr.en: You seemed very sure of yourselves in the exam.
tr.nl: Jullie kwamen heel zeker over bij het examen.

text: Al professore siete sembrati bravi studenti.

tr.en: The teacher thought you seemed like good students.
tr.nl: De leraar vond jullie goede studenten.

text: Non mi siete sembrati sorpresi.

tr.en: You didn't seem surprised to me.
tr.nl: Jullie leken me niet verrast.

text: Voi siete sembrati tranquilli, ma io no.

tr.en: You guys seemed calm, but I didn't.
tr.nl: Jullie leken rustig, maar ik niet.

text: Oggi mi siete sembrate abbastanza nervose.

tr.en: You seemed quite nervous to me today.
tr.nl: Jullie leken me vandaag nogal zenuwachtig.

text: Le domande mi sono sembrate difficili.

tr.en: The questions seemed difficult to me.
tr.nl: De vragen leken me moeilijk.

text: Gli studenti sono sembrati annoiati durante la lezione.

tr.en: The students seemed bored during the lesson.
tr.nl: De studenten leken zich te vervelen tijdens de les.

text: Le tue sorelle sono sembrate molto orgogliose di te.

tr.en: Your sisters seemed very proud of you.
tr.nl: Je zussen leken erg trots op je.

text: I miei genitori sono sembrati sorpresi.

tr.en: My parents seemed surprised.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders leken verrast.

text: Loro sono sembrati molto preoccupati per te.

tr.en: They seemed very worried about you.
tr.nl: Ze leken erg bezorgd om je.

text: Sono piaciuta ai tuoi genitori?

tr.en: Did your parents like me?
tr.nl: Vonden je ouders me aardig?

text: Io non sono piaciuto a tua madre.

tr.en: Your mother didn't like me.
tr.nl: Je moeder vond me niet aardig.

text: Ti sono piaciuto subito?

tr.en: Did you like me right away?
tr.nl: Vond je me meteen leuk?

text: Io gli sono piaciuta, ma lui non mi piace.

tr.en: He liked me, but I don't like him.
tr.nl: Hij vond mij leuk, maar ik vind hem niet leuk.

text: Sei piaciuta ai miei genitori.

tr.en: My parents liked you.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders vonden je aardig.

text: Tu sei piaciuto molto ai bambini.

tr.en: The children really liked you.
tr.nl: De kinderen vonden jou heel leuk.

text: Sai che sei piaciuta al mio capo?

tr.en: Did you know my boss liked you?
tr.nl: Weet je dat mijn baas je goed vond?

text: Siamo piaciuti molto ai tuoi amici.

tr.en: Your friends really liked us.
tr.nl: Je vrienden vonden ons heel leuk.

text: Noi non siamo piaciuti alla nonna.

tr.en: Grandma didn't like us.
tr.nl: Oma vond ons niet aardig.

text: Vi siamo piaciuti?

tr.en: Did you like us?
tr.nl: Vonden jullie ons leuk?

text: Al professore siamo piaciuti, credo.

tr.en: The teacher liked us, I think.
tr.nl: De leraar vond ons goed, denk ik.

text: Pensi che siamo piaciuti ai tuoi nonni?

tr.en: Do you think your grandparents liked us?
tr.nl: Denk je dat je opa en oma ons aardig vonden?

text: Siamo piaciute alla gente del paese.

tr.en: The village people liked us.
tr.nl: De mensen uit het dorp vonden ons aardig.

text: Siete piaciuti molto alla mia famiglia.

tr.en: My family really liked you.
tr.nl: Mijn familie vond jullie heel aardig.

text: Voi siete piaciute subito a mio fratello.

tr.en: My brother liked you right away.
tr.nl: Mijn broer vond jullie meteen leuk.

text: Siete piaciuti anche ai bambini.

tr.en: The children liked you too.
tr.nl: De kinderen vonden jullie ook leuk.

text: Ci siete piaciuti molto, ragazzi!

tr.en: We really liked you, guys!
tr.nl: We vonden jullie heel leuk, jongens!

text: Al capo siete piaciuti molto.

tr.en: The boss liked you a lot.
tr.nl: De baas vond jullie erg goed.

text: Perché non siete piaciuti a sua madre?

tr.en: Why didn't his mother like you?
tr.nl: Waarom vond zijn moeder jullie niet aardig?

text: I biscotti della nonna mi sono piaciuti molto.

tr.en: I really liked grandma's cookies.
tr.nl: Ik vond de koekjes van oma erg lekker.

text: Ti sono piaciute le fragole?

tr.en: Did you like the strawberries?
tr.nl: Vond je de aardbeien lekker?

text: Siete riusciti a parlare con il medico?

tr.en: Did you manage to talk to the doctor?
tr.nl: Hebben jullie de dokter kunnen spreken?

text: Le mie sorelle sono riuscite a trovare un lavoro.

tr.en: My sisters managed to find a job.
tr.nl: Mijn zussen hebben een baan weten te vinden.

text: Gli studenti sono riusciti a finire il progetto.

tr.en: The students managed to finish the project.
tr.nl: De studenten hebben het project af kunnen maken.

text: Perché siete diventati così nervosi?

tr.en: Why have you become so irritable?
tr.nl: Waarom zijn jullie zo prikkelbaar geworden?

text: Siamo restati a casa per il freddo.

tr.en: We stayed at home because of the cold.
tr.nl: We zijn thuisgebleven vanwege de kou.

text: Noi siamo restate in albergo.

tr.en: We stayed at the hotel.
tr.nl: Wij zijn in het hotel gebleven.

text: Siamo restati senza soldi.

tr.en: We ran out of money.
tr.nl: We zaten zonder geld.

text: I ragazzi sono restati a scuola fino alle sei.

tr.en: The boys stayed at school until six.
tr.nl: De jongens zijn tot zes uur op school gebleven.

text: Le mie amiche sono restate al mare una settimana.

tr.en: My friends stayed at the seaside for a week.
tr.nl: Mijn vriendinnen zijn een week aan zee gebleven.

text: Non avevamo soldi per il viaggio.

tr.en: We had no money for the trip.
tr.nl: We hadden geen geld voor de reis.

text: Noi avevamo lezione ogni lunedì.

tr.en: We had class every Monday.
tr.nl: We hadden elke maandag les.

text: Andavi al lavoro in treno o in macchina?

tr.en: Did you go to work by train or by car?
tr.nl: Ging je met de trein of met de auto naar je werk?

text: Facevo i compiti in cucina da ragazzo.

tr.en: As a boy I did my homework in the kitchen.
tr.nl: Als jongen maakte ik mijn huiswerk in de keuken.

text: Facevi spesso domande all'insegnante.

tr.en: You often asked the teacher questions.
tr.nl: Je stelde de leraar vaak vragen.

text: Facevi il cameriere in un ristorante?

tr.en: Did you work as a waiter in a restaurant?
tr.nl: Werkte je als ober in een restaurant?

text: Facevi sempre tardi a lezione.

tr.en: You were always late for class.
tr.nl: Je kwam altijd te laat in de les.

text: Mentre facevamo i compiti, la mamma cucinava.

tr.en: While we were doing our homework, mum was cooking.
tr.nl: Terwijl wij ons huiswerk maakten, kookte mama.

text: Facevate i compiti insieme?

tr.en: Did you do your homework together?
tr.nl: Maakten jullie samen huiswerk?

text: Volevamo parlare con il dottore.

tr.en: We wanted to talk to the doctor.
tr.nl: We wilden met de dokter praten.

text: Noi sapevamo la risposta.

tr.en: We knew the answer.
tr.nl: Wij wisten het antwoord.

text: Dicevi che tuo padre era medico.

tr.en: You said your father was a doctor.
tr.nl: Je zei dat je vader arts was.

text: Noi dicevamo sempre grazie al cameriere.

tr.en: We always said thank you to the waiter.
tr.nl: We zeiden altijd dankjewel tegen de ober.

text: Perché dicevate che ero nervoso?

tr.en: Why did you say I was nervous?
tr.nl: Waarom zeiden jullie dat ik zenuwachtig was?

text: Le mie amiche dicevano che ero gelosa.

tr.en: My friends said I was jealous.
tr.nl: Mijn vriendinnen zeiden dat ik jaloers was.

text: Vi vedevate spesso dopo il lavoro?

tr.en: Did you often see each other after work?
tr.nl: Zagen jullie elkaar vaak na het werk?

text: Vedevate il capo ogni mattina?

tr.en: Did you see the boss every morning?
tr.nl: Zagen jullie de baas elke ochtend?

text: Gli studenti vedevano il professore solo a lezione.

tr.en: The students only saw the professor in class.
tr.nl: De studenten zagen de professor alleen tijdens de les.

text: Pensavi a me durante la lezione?

tr.en: Were you thinking of me during the lesson?
tr.nl: Dacht je tijdens de les aan mij?

text: Mentre io cucinavo, tu pensavi al lavoro.

tr.en: While I was cooking, you were thinking about work.
tr.nl: Terwijl ik kookte, dacht jij aan je werk.

text: Pensavate molto agli esami all'università?

tr.en: Did you think a lot about exams at university?
tr.nl: Dachten jullie op de universiteit veel aan de examens?

text: Voi pensavate sempre al lavoro, anche in vacanza.

tr.en: You were always thinking about work, even on holiday.
tr.nl: Jullie dachten altijd aan jullie werk, zelfs op vakantie.

text: Perché non venivi mai a lezione?

tr.en: Why did you never come to class?
tr.nl: Waarom kwam je nooit naar de les?

text: Ragazzi, venivate anche voi alla riunione del lunedì?

tr.en: Guys, did you also come to the Monday meeting?
tr.nl: Jongens, kwamen jullie ook naar de vergadering op maandag?

text: Scusa, parlavo con la mia collega.

tr.en: Sorry, I was talking to my colleague.
tr.nl: Sorry, ik was met mijn collega aan het praten.

text: Tu parlavi sempre del tuo lavoro.

tr.en: You always talked about your work.
tr.nl: Jij praatte altijd over je werk.

text: Perché parlavi con il professore?

tr.en: Why were you talking to the teacher?
tr.nl: Waarom praatte je met de leraar?

text: Parlavate di lavoro anche a cena?

tr.en: Did you talk about work even at dinner?
tr.nl: Praatten jullie zelfs tijdens het eten over werk?

text: Voi parlavate troppo in classe.

tr.en: You talked too much in class.
tr.nl: Jullie praatten te veel in de klas.

text: Io non capivo la domanda del professore.

tr.en: I didn't understand the teacher's question.
tr.nl: Ik begreep de vraag van de leraar niet.

text: Capivi quello che diceva il professore?

tr.en: Did you understand what the teacher was saying?
tr.nl: Begreep je wat de leraar zei?

text: Tu non capivi mai le mie domande.

tr.en: You never understood my questions.
tr.nl: Jij begreep mijn vragen nooit.

text: Non capivi perché ero arrabbiato?

tr.en: Didn't you understand why I was angry?
tr.nl: Begreep je niet waarom ik boos was?

text: Noi non capivamo la lezione.

tr.en: We didn't understand the lesson.
tr.nl: Wij begrepen de les niet.

text: Capivamo la domanda, ma non la risposta.

tr.en: We understood the question, but not the answer.
tr.nl: We begrepen de vraag, maar niet het antwoord.

text: In vacanza non capivamo il cameriere.

tr.en: On holiday we couldn't understand the waiter.
tr.nl: Op vakantie verstonden we de ober niet.

text: Capivate bene il professore?

tr.en: Did you understand the teacher well?
tr.nl: Verstonden jullie de leraar goed?

text: Voi non capivate la mia domanda.

tr.en: You didn't understand my question.
tr.nl: Jullie begrepen mijn vraag niet.

text: Voi capivate bene le mie emozioni.

tr.en: You understood my feelings well.
tr.nl: Jullie begrepen mijn gevoelens goed.

text: Ragazzi, capivate i compiti di ieri?

tr.en: Guys, did you understand yesterday's homework?
tr.nl: Jongens, snapten jullie het huiswerk van gisteren?

text: I miei genitori non capivano il mio lavoro.

tr.en: My parents didn't understand my job.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders begrepen mijn werk niet.

text: Gli studenti aspettavano il professore in classe.

tr.en: The students were waiting for the teacher in the classroom.
tr.nl: De studenten wachtten in het lokaal op de leraar.

text: Noi sembravamo tranquilli, ma avevamo paura.

tr.en: We seemed calm, but we were afraid.
tr.nl: We leken rustig, maar we waren bang.

text: Io prendevo la bicicletta per andare al lavoro.

tr.en: I used to take my bike to work.
tr.nl: Ik pakte altijd de fiets naar mijn werk.

text: Perché prendevi sempre la mia penna?

tr.en: Why did you always take my pen?
tr.nl: Waarom pakte je altijd mijn pen?

text: Prendevi spesso l'aereo per lavoro?

tr.en: Did you often fly for work?
tr.nl: Vloog je vaak voor je werk?

text: Ragazzi, prendevate voi le mie matite?

tr.en: Guys, were you the ones taking my pencils?
tr.nl: Jongens, pakten jullie mijn potloden?

text: I cuochi prendevano la verdura al mercato.

tr.en: The cooks got their vegetables at the market.
tr.nl: De koks haalden hun groente op de markt.

text: Tu piacevi molto a mia madre.

tr.en: My mother liked you a lot.
tr.nl: Mijn moeder vond jou heel aardig.

text: Sapevi che piacevi a Luca?

tr.en: Did you know Luca liked you?
tr.nl: Wist je dat Luca je leuk vond?

text: Tu piacevi ai miei nonni.

tr.en: My grandparents liked you.
tr.nl: Mijn opa en oma vonden jou aardig.

text: Noi piacevamo molto all'insegnante.

tr.en: The teacher liked us a lot.
tr.nl: De leraar mocht ons erg graag.

text: Piacevamo ai vostri genitori?

tr.en: Did your parents like us?
tr.nl: Vonden jullie ouders ons aardig?

text: Io e Anna non piacevamo al capo.

tr.en: The boss didn't like Anna and me.
tr.nl: De baas mocht Anna en mij niet.

text: Forse non piacevamo alla tua famiglia.

tr.en: Maybe your family didn't like us.
tr.nl: Misschien vond je familie ons niet aardig.

text: Voi piacevate molto ai miei figli.

tr.en: My children liked you a lot.
tr.nl: Mijn kinderen vonden jullie heel leuk.

text: Piacevate al nonno? - Sì, molto.

tr.en: Did grandpa like you? - Yes, a lot.
tr.nl: Vond opa jullie aardig? - Ja, heel erg.

text: Voi non piacevate a mio padre.

tr.en: My father didn't like you.
tr.nl: Mijn vader mocht jullie niet.

text: Diremo al capo che il progetto è pronto.

tr.en: We'll tell the boss that the project is ready.
tr.nl: We zeggen tegen de baas dat het project klaar is.

text: Dopo l'esame tu penserai solo alle vacanze.

tr.en: After the exam you'll only think about the holidays.
tr.nl: Na het examen denk je alleen nog aan de vakantie.

text: Al mare non penserai al lavoro.

tr.en: At the seaside you won't think about work.
tr.nl: Aan zee denk je niet aan je werk.

text: Noi penseremo ai bambini, tranquillo.

tr.en: We'll look after the children, don't worry.
tr.nl: Wij zorgen voor de kinderen, maak je geen zorgen.

text: In montagna non penserete agli esami.

tr.en: In the mountains you won't think about the exams.
tr.nl: In de bergen denken jullie niet aan de examens.

text: Lo capiremo dopo la lezione.

tr.en: We'll understand it after the lesson.
tr.nl: Na de les begrijpen we het wel.

text: Capiremo quando il professore spiegherà.

tr.en: We'll understand when the teacher explains.
tr.nl: We begrijpen het wel als de leraar het uitlegt.

text: Capiremo la lezione senza il libro?

tr.en: Will we understand the lesson without the book?
tr.nl: Begrijpen we de les zonder het boek?

text: Capiremo subito cosa vuole il capo.

tr.en: We'll understand right away what the boss wants.
tr.nl: We snappen meteen wat de baas wil.

text: Dopo l'esame mi sentirò finalmente tranquillo.

tr.en: After the exam I'll finally feel relaxed.
tr.nl: Na het examen ben ik eindelijk gerust.

text: Ci sentiremo dopo la riunione.

tr.en: We'll talk after the meeting.
tr.nl: We spreken elkaar na de vergadering.

text: Sentiremo cosa dice il dottore.

tr.en: We'll hear what the doctor says.
tr.nl: We horen wel wat de dokter zegt.

text: Domani Marco e Lucia sentiranno il dottore.

tr.en: Tomorrow Marco and Lucia will talk to the doctor.
tr.nl: Morgen spreken Marco en Lucia de dokter.

text: Forse ti sembrerò troppo nervoso.

tr.en: Maybe I'll seem too nervous to you.
tr.nl: Misschien kom ik te nerveus op je over.

text: Sembrerai calmo anche se sei nervoso.

tr.en: You'll seem calm even if you're nervous.
tr.nl: Je zult rustig lijken, ook al ben je zenuwachtig.

text: L'esame sembrerà difficile, ma non lo è.

tr.en: The exam will seem hard, but it isn't.
tr.nl: Het examen lijkt moeilijk, maar dat is het niet.

text: Mio padre sembrerà arrabbiato, ma è solo stanco.

tr.en: My father will seem angry, but he's just tired.
tr.nl: Mijn vader lijkt boos, maar hij is gewoon moe.

text: Se non parliamo, sembreremo arrabbiati.

tr.en: If we don't talk, we'll seem angry.
tr.nl: Als we niet praten, lijken we boos.

text: Sembrerete sorpresi, ma lo sapete già.

tr.en: You'll look surprised, but you already know.
tr.nl: Jullie zullen verrast lijken, maar jullie weten het al.

text: Voi sembrerete tranquilli, ma io no.

tr.en: You'll seem calm, but I won't.
tr.nl: Jullie zullen rustig lijken, maar ik niet.

text: Al capo voi sembrerete nervosi.

tr.en: You'll seem nervous to the boss.
tr.nl: Op de baas komen jullie nerveus over.

text: I tuoi nonni sembreranno calmi, ma sono preoccupati.

tr.en: Your grandparents will seem calm, but they're worried.
tr.nl: Je opa en oma lijken rustig, maar ze maken zich zorgen.

text: Le domande dell'esame sembreranno facili.

tr.en: The exam questions will seem easy.
tr.nl: De examenvragen zullen makkelijk lijken.

text: Piacerai molto a mia madre.

tr.en: My mother will really like you.
tr.nl: Mijn moeder zal je heel aardig vinden.

text: Ai bambini tu piacerai subito.

tr.en: The children will like you right away.
tr.nl: De kinderen zullen je meteen leuk vinden.

text: Tu piacerai al capo, sei così gentile.

tr.en: The boss will like you, you're so kind.
tr.nl: De baas zal je mogen, je bent zo aardig.

text: Piacerai anche ai miei amici.

tr.en: My friends will like you too.
tr.nl: Mijn vrienden zullen je ook leuk vinden.

text: Piaceremo ai tuoi genitori?

tr.en: Will your parents like us?
tr.nl: Zullen je ouders ons aardig vinden?

text: Forse non piaceremo alla nonna.

tr.en: Maybe grandma won't like us.
tr.nl: Misschien vindt oma ons niet aardig.

text: Al professore non piaceremo mai.

tr.en: The teacher will never like us.
tr.nl: De leraar zal ons nooit mogen.

text: Piaceremo anche a tuo fratello?

tr.en: Will your brother like us too?
tr.nl: Vindt je broer ons ook leuk?

text: Noi piaceremo a Sara, ne sono sicuro.

tr.en: Sara will like us, I'm sure of it.
tr.nl: Sara zal ons aardig vinden, dat weet ik zeker.

text: Piacerete molto ai miei genitori.

tr.en: My parents will like you a lot.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders zullen jullie heel aardig vinden.

text: Piacerete alla nonna con questa torta.

tr.en: Grandma will like you with this cake.
tr.nl: Met deze taart zal oma jullie wel mogen.

text: Piacerete anche voi ai bambini.

tr.en: The children will like you too.
tr.nl: De kinderen zullen jullie ook leuk vinden.

text: Cercherai un lavoro a Milano?

tr.en: Will you look for a job in Milan?
tr.nl: Ga je werk zoeken in Milaan?

text: Cercherete di parlare con il capo?

tr.en: Will you try to talk to the boss?
tr.nl: Proberen jullie met de baas te praten?

text: Gli studenti conosceranno il nuovo professore lunedì.

tr.en: The students will meet the new teacher on Monday.
tr.nl: Maandag maken de studenten kennis met de nieuwe leraar.

text: Farai i compiti domani pomeriggio?

tr.en: Will you do your homework tomorrow afternoon?
tr.nl: Doe je morgenmiddag je huiswerk?

text: Domani farete un esame difficile.

tr.en: Tomorrow you'll take a difficult exam.
tr.nl: Morgen doen jullie een moeilijk examen.

text: Vorrò parlare con il capo domani.

tr.en: I'll want to talk to the boss tomorrow.
tr.nl: Ik wil morgen met de baas praten.

text: Tra un anno tu vorrai un lavoro nuovo.

tr.en: In a year you'll want a new job.
tr.nl: Over een jaar wil je een nieuwe baan.

text: Domani noi vorremo parlare con il medico.

tr.en: Tomorrow we'll want to speak to the doctor.
tr.nl: Morgen willen we de dokter spreken.

text: In albergo noi vorremo una camera tranquilla.

tr.en: At the hotel we'll want a quiet room.
tr.nl: In het hotel willen we een rustige kamer.

text: Voi vorrete mangiare dopo la lezione.

tr.en: You'll want to eat after the lesson.
tr.nl: Na de les willen jullie vast eten.

text: Finalmente potrai andare in vacanza dopo l'esame.

tr.en: You'll finally be able to go on holiday after the exam.
tr.nl: Na het examen kun je eindelijk op vakantie.

text: Quando mi potrai dare una risposta?

tr.en: When will you be able to give me an answer?
tr.nl: Wanneer kun je me een antwoord geven?

text: Il medico ti potrà vedere domani.

tr.en: The doctor will be able to see you tomorrow.
tr.nl: De dokter kan je morgen ontvangen.

text: Purtroppo non potremo restare a cena.

tr.en: Unfortunately we won't be able to stay for dinner.
tr.nl: Helaas kunnen we niet blijven eten.

text: Potrete guardare la televisione dopo i compiti.

tr.en: You'll be able to watch television after your homework.
tr.nl: Na het huiswerk mogen jullie televisie kijken.

text: Forse i nonni potranno restare una settimana.

tr.en: Maybe our grandparents will be able to stay for a week.
tr.nl: Misschien kunnen opa en oma een week blijven.

text: Saprò la risposta domani.

tr.en: I'll know the answer tomorrow.
tr.nl: Morgen weet ik het antwoord.

text: Io saprò cosa fare dopo la riunione.

tr.en: I'll know what to do after the meeting.
tr.nl: Na de vergadering weet ik wat ik moet doen.

text: Saprete la risposta lunedì.

tr.en: You'll know the answer on Monday.
tr.nl: Maandag weten jullie het antwoord.

text: Voi saprete cucinare la pasta dopo questa lezione.

tr.en: You'll know how to cook pasta after this lesson.
tr.nl: Na deze les kunnen jullie pasta koken.

text: Il professore terrà una lezione sul cinema.

tr.en: The professor will give a lecture on cinema.
tr.nl: De professor geeft een college over film.

text: Noi terremo la riunione in ufficio.

tr.en: We'll hold the meeting in the office.
tr.nl: We houden de vergadering op kantoor.

text: Terrete i soldi in banca?

tr.en: Will you keep the money in the bank?
tr.nl: Bewaren jullie het geld op de bank?

text: Terranno la riunione domani mattina.

tr.en: They'll hold the meeting tomorrow morning.
tr.nl: Ze houden de vergadering morgenochtend.

text: Dove vivrai dopo l'università?

tr.en: Where will you live after university?
tr.nl: Waar ga je wonen na de universiteit?

text: Tu vivrai bene con questo stipendio.

tr.en: You'll live well on this salary.
tr.nl: Met dit salaris kun je goed leven.

text: Vivremo al nord per il lavoro di Marco.

tr.en: We'll live in the north for Marco's job.
tr.nl: We gaan in het noorden wonen voor het werk van Marco.

text: Noi berremo una birra dopo il lavoro.

tr.en: We'll have a beer after work.
tr.nl: We drinken een biertje na het werk.

text: Gli studenti berranno un caffè prima dell'esame.

tr.en: The students will have a coffee before the exam.
tr.nl: De studenten drinken een koffie voor het examen.

text: Io ottengo sempre una risposta.

tr.en: I always get an answer.
tr.nl: Ik krijg altijd een antwoord.

text: Loro ottengono sempre una risposta.

tr.en: They always get an answer.
tr.nl: Zij krijgen altijd een antwoord.

text: Noi capiamo la domanda.

tr.en: We understand the question.
tr.nl: Wij begrijpen de vraag.

text: Noi finiamo il lavoro.

tr.en: We finish the work.
tr.nl: Wij maken het werk af.
